_comment: How far from the nearest enemy a ranged monster ends its turn (Managers.MonsterStandoffs). Without a
row a ranged monster ends at the reach of its best blow, out of sight when it can.
cells     the distance it keeps from the nearest enemy

standoffs.why: Yokai ruidoso, the library fight of «En la encrucijada de los mundos» (2150). Its kit: Yokunai (16975, 3-10), Trokai (16976, 3-6), Telepyokai (16977, 4-8) and Yoku (16980), a push of four from exactly two cells. The fight is won by putting all five yokais to sleep with «Yokaido Do» (16932, range 1-2) in the same turn; each cast also takes one MP for the rest of the fight (alucare: «Le sort permet également d'enlever un PM, c'est cumulable et infini»). INFERRED: that they end their turn at Yoku's two cells. Kept at Yokunai's ten, out of sight, with ten MP, none could be reached in 40 rounds.
Yokai tronchado, the same fight and kit as the Yokai ruidoso (6237): Yoku (16980) pushes from exactly two cells. INFERRED: that it ends its turn at two cells.
Yokai escandaloso, the same fight and kit as the Yokai ruidoso (6237): Yoku (16980) pushes from exactly two cells. INFERRED: that it ends its turn at two cells.
